data.one_liner: A Dart and Flutter package for using, converting, and formatting Jalali and Gregorian calendars.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to work with both Jalali (Shamsi/Solar/Persian) and Gregorian (Miladi) calendars. It supports date conversions, formatting, manipulation, and time information.
use_when: You need to display or manipulate Jalali (Shamsi) calendar dates in a Flutter or Dart application.
You need to convert between Jalali, Gregorian, and standard DateTime objects.
avoid_when: You only need standard Gregorian dates and do not require Persian calendar support.
strengths: Comprehensive support for Jalali calendar calculations and conversions.
Immutable date objects with robust validation and exception handling.
High test coverage and pure Dart implementation.
weaknesses: Does not store timezone information internally within date objects.
